n = int(input())
b = int(input)
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
j = 0
count = 0
cut = [0] * n

even = 0
odd = 0
for i in range(n):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        even += 1
    else:
        odd += 1
    if even == odd and i != n - 1:
        cut[j] = i + 1
        even = 0
        odd = 0
        j += 1

if j > 1:
    bitcoin = [0] * j
    for i in range(j):
        bitcoin[i] = arr[cut[i]] - arr[cut[i] - 1]
        if bitcoin[i] < 0:
            bitcoin[i] *= -1
    bitcoin.sort()
    if bitcoin[0] > b:
        count = 0
    else:
        for i in range(1, j):
            bitcoin[i] += bitcoin[i - 1]
            if bitcoin[i] > b:
                count = i
                break
            else:
                count = i + 1
else:
    if j == 0:
        count = 0
    else:
        a = arr[cut[0]] - arr[cut[0] - 1]
        if a < 0:
            a *= -1
        if j == 1 and a >= b:
            count = 1

print(count)
</translated_code>
